name: net_away_and_back
description: Client 2 goes silent for 6 s: the sequencer's AWAY (wire seat 1) marks simulation seat 2 away on both clients and the caretaker counts it Ready; when it speaks again BACK hands it back at the next window, and the hashes agree throughout.

steps.msg: after 5 s of silence the sequencer sent AWAY for wire seat 1
client 1's simulation marks seat 2 away, not seat 1
the caretaker's seat counts as Ready
its first message after the stall sent BACK
both simulations hold the seat for the caretaker until the next window
a command before the hand-back is refused
every hash agreed through away and back
